item.title: Second round of ground scans done at controversial dorm site
item.description: Data collected Saturday during ground-penetrating radar (GPR) scans at 106 Coming St. will be processed within two weeks to inform the College of Charleston of what’s in the ground where the college wants to build a new dormitory, a college scientist said.
